verdict.rationale: Working Copy documents two AI features: AI-suggested commit messages based on staged diffs (docs-5) and a conversational 'Repository Agent' that can browse, search, read/modify files, commit, pull and push (docs-29) — both surface AI-generated insight/suggestions from the user's repository data. However, evidence is entirely first-party docs with no independent/hands-on validation of quality or reliability, and no detail on depth of 'insights' beyond commit messages and agentic file actions. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the Repository Agent's real-world usefulness, and richer detail on what kinds of data insights (beyond commit suggestions) are generated.
